name: (Woodblessed) Reactive Flare
text:
Trigger The woodblessed is damaged by a creature within their reach

---

Effect Distracted by the pain, the woodblessed's concentration slips and splinters erupt from their body as they temporarily lose control of the planar energy within them. Both the triggering creature and the woodblessed take 1d6 piercing damage + 1d6 per 2 levels the woodblessed has, with a basic Reflex save save against the woodblessed's spell DC.
